question:
设向量 $\alpha_1 = \begin{pmatrix} 1 \\ 0 \\ 1 \end{pmatrix}$，$\alpha_2 = \begin{pmatrix} 0 \\ 1 \\ 1 \end{pmatrix}$，$\alpha_3 = \begin{pmatrix} 1 \\ 1 \\ 0 \end{pmatrix}$.
$(1)$将 $\alpha_1,\alpha_2,\alpha_3$ 化成正交单位向量组 $\gamma_1,\gamma_2,\gamma_3$；
$(2)$ 若 $(\alpha_1,\alpha_2,\alpha_3) = (\gamma_1,\gamma_2,\gamma_3)C$，求 $C$.
